title: Professional Leadership and Community Engagement
description: Role of leadership and community engagement in professional engineering. Leadership and engagement styles. In-depth discussion of case studies from different areas of practice. Professional standards, laws, and regulations. Community-involved decision-making. Sustainability and sustainable practice. Safety-awareness and practice review. Strategy development and risk management. Bias recognition, mitigation and avoidance. Communication with diverse audiences. De-colonization and truth and reconciliation.

prerequisites.text: Admission to MEng program in Aerospace Systems Engineering, Applied Data Science, Biomedical Systems, Building Envelopes and Structures, Industrial Ecology, or Telecommunications and Information Security.
